introduction.body: Thank you for downloading the SpinShare desktop client! Before you can begin downloading charts from the SpinShare community, we need to go through our initial setup.

game.tip: Tip: To store your custom charts in a different folder or on a different drive, you can add {code} to your steam launch options.

cache.body: To easily display whether you already have a chart installed and whether an update is available, a cache needs to be build.
cache.explanation: This cache goes through your game's custom charts folder and creates a smaller text file with all existing charts. It also creates a small thumbnail of the album art so your browsing experience is more stable, even with many charts installed.
cache.timeNeeded: If you have not installed any Spin Rhythm XD custom charts yet, this step will be instant. If you have a very large library, it may take up to a minute.
cache.tip: Tip: You can always re-analyze your library in the library tab.

done.body: You have now set up the SpinShare desktop client. You're only a click away from a library of thousands of custom created charts for Spin Rhythm XD.
done.tip: Tip: Click on the top right corner to log into your account. Logging in lets you review charts and add them to playlists comfortably without using the website. In the future, you'll also be able to upload your own custom charts.
done.welcome: But for now, let's enter the rhythm dimension!
